details:
Artemis MedCore is an AI-powered astronaut health operations and emergency response platform designed to support future Moon, Mars, and deep-space missions.

The platform helps astronauts monitor, manage, and understand their health in environments where immediate medical support from Earth may not be available. Artemis MedCore enables astronauts to record vital signs, log symptoms, connect health-monitoring devices, perform camera-based pulse measurements, and analyze health data through interactive telemetry dashboards with historical trends, threshold monitoring, habitat-aware tracking, telemetry logs, synchronization tools, and exportable data.

To improve health awareness, the platform includes interactive body-system modules and 3D bio-telemetry visualizations covering cardiovascular, neurological, respiratory, musculoskeletal, immune, ocular, metabolic, and dermal health. Astronauts can also access health manuals, preventive guidance, readiness tracking, routine management tools, and calibration workflows for health-monitoring equipment.

Artemis MedCore features Flight Surgeon AI, which provides health guidance, educational support, and mission-focused assistance. The platform also includes Star, a voice-enabled mission assistant capable of dictation, note-taking, communication support, logging, and hands-free interaction. During emergencies, astronauts can activate Voice SOS and simply say “Emergency,” allowing Star to automatically alert contacts, crew groups, and rescue teams while recording the incident for mission awareness and response coordination.

To educate astronauts about mission risks, the platform includes information on major human-spaceflight hazards, including radiation exposure, isolation and confinement, altered gravity, hostile environments, and distance from Earth. These resources help astronauts understand risks, symptoms, and recommended countermeasures.

The platform also includes crew communication systems, contact and group management, emergency rescue coordination, onboarding through Astro, customizable light and dark modes, mission logging, and health-data synchronization.

AI was used throughout development as a research, design, and development assistant. AI assisted with the creation of interface components, visualizations, animations, onboarding experiences, Flight Surgeon AI, Star, emergency-response workflows, telemetry displays, icons, and research related to astronaut health. However, the overall concept, mission objectives, astronaut-health workflows, emergency-response architecture, feature selection, system integration, user experience design, and project direction were conceived, customized, and directed by our team.

Artemis MedCore is creative because it combines health monitoring, astronaut education, AI-assisted medical guidance, crew communication, accessibility features, and emergency response into a single integrated platform. Our team focused on astronaut safety, usability, accessibility, emergency preparedness, health awareness, and long-duration mission challenges to create a solution that supports both astronaut wellbeing and mission success.

Our intended impact is to make future space missions safer, smarter, and more resilient by giving astronauts the tools they need to monitor their health, respond to emergencies, stay informed, and maintain mission readiness when Earth is millions of kilometers away.
